thought.text: Both Docker images pulled. Let me wait for the Ruby build to complete.

reasoning_content: Both dependency images were pulled successfully. Ruby is still compiling on 8 cores. Let me wait for the Ruby build to finish. It takes a few minutes. Let me poll it.

action.command:
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if [ -f /tmp/ruby_build.done ]; then echo "DONE"; break; fi
  sleep 20
done
cat /tmp/ruby_build.done 2>/dev/null || echo "still building after wait"
tail -3 /tmp/ruby_make.log 2>/dev/null
